html:
Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 3 days and 2 nights in Sapa, saving time while still visiting the most popular attractions. Guests will stay overnight in a comfortable hotel and conquer Fansipan Peak – “The Roof of Indochina.” Friendly and attentive service is provided throughout the journey.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa by Bus – Short Trek to Cat Cat Village

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:40

Meet at the bus station, board the sleeper bus, and depart for Sapa.

07:30 – 11:45

Travel along the highway to Lao Cai City with a comfort break.

11:45 – 13:00

Continue on the mountain road approaching Sapa Town, enjoying scenic views of valleys and terraced rice fields.

13:00 – 13:30

Arrive in Sapa Town, where ethnic groups such as the H’Mong, Dzao, and Tay appear in colorful traditional clothing.

  • Welcome drink and itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30

Take a short drive to the gate of Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong people and located at the bottom of a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

Your local guide will introduce village activities and local culture as you trek down to the valley to visit the waterfall and the Hydroelectric Power Station built by the French. After some time for photos at the bridge and waterfall, trek uphill to reach the main road.

The driver will pick you up and transfer you back to Sapa.

17:00

Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel. Free time for night activities.

Day 2: Sapa – Fansipan Peak – Glass Bridge – Lonely Tree – Silver Waterfall – Sapa

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

08:00

After breakfast at the hotel, the driver and tour guide will take you to the Cable Car Station. Enjoy a 20-minute cable car ride with spectacular mountain scenery.

09:00

Reach 2,800 meters above sea level. Spend time sightseeing, taking photos, visiting the spiritual pagoda complex, and trekking up 600 steps to reach Fansipan Peak – the Roof of Indochina. (Approx. 1.5 hours for hiking and photography)

11:30

Return to the Cable Car Station and head back to Sapa Town.

12:00

Lunch at a local restaurant or at the hotel.

13:30

Begin your exploration of Dragon Cloud, Glass Bridge, Lonely Tree, and Silver Waterfall.

Along the way, stop at the summit of O Quy Ho Pass (2,333 meters), one of Vietnam’s Four Great Passes. This is a prime location for cloud hunting and panoramic photos.

At the Dragon Cloud Glass Bridge, you may:

  • Check in at the colorful staircase

  • Take the elevator to the Hao Han Qiao Glass Bridge (three transparent sides)

  • Walk along the 768-meter glass walkway perched 1,000 meters above the mountainside

  • Enjoy free time for photos and explore optional activities within the tourist zone

17:00

Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel.

Day 3: Sapa – Moana View – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

07:30

Have breakfast at the hotel, then take a short walk to Moana View, the latest check-in spot designed especially for young travelers who love unique photo settings.

Moana View highlights include:

  • Bali Gate

  • Infinity Lake

  • Moana Girl Statue

  • Golden Hand

  • Thrilling Swing

  • Lonely Tree

  • Panoramic Café with views of Fansipan Peak and Muong Hoa Valley

Prepare beautiful outfits and accessories to capture your best photos.

11:30

Return to the hotel for check-out.

12:00

Enjoy lunch and free time in Sapa.

13:00 – 14:00

Board the bus back to Hanoi with comfort breaks along the way.

20:00 – 20:30

Arrive at Hanoi bus station. The trip ends.

Trip Includes

  • Sleeper bus ticket Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi (tour guide not available on the bus)

  • English-speaking tour guide during the trip in Sapa

  • Double/twin hotel room (based on twin sharing)

  • Meals: 3 lunches, 2 dinners, 2 breakfasts

  • All entrance tickets as mentioned in the itinerary

Trip Excludes

  • Cable car return ticket Sapa – Fansipan – Sapa:

    • 32 USD (weekday)

    • 35 USD (Saturday)

  • Government tax and beverages

  • Tips for tour guides and drivers, travel insurance

  • Services not clearly listed

  • Sleeper bus cabin surcharge:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD per person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: 8 USD per person (round trip)

  • Dcar Limousine VIP seat surcharge: 20 USD per person (round trip)

  • Luxury Limousine 28-seat Nouble surcharge: 16 USD per person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Children under 5 years (or under 1 meter): Free of charge (based on 2 adults + 1 child sharing bed/berth/bus seat)

  • Children from 5 – 8 years old: 75% of adult price, sharing bed with adult

  • Children from 9 years old and above: Charged as adult

Surcharge Policy

  • A surcharge applies during National Holidays

What to Bring

  • Warm clothes, scarf, hat, cap (Sapa is cold from September to March)

  • Note: Sapa is often foggy in December, January, February, and March

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sunscreen, insect repellent

  • Cash in Vietnam Dong (banking services in Sapa may be unstable; USD, EUR, AUD accepted)

Tour Price per Person

  • 162 USD per person – 3-star hotel

  • 172 USD per person – 4-star hotel

  • 216 USD per person – 5-star hotel
